outline.title: Call 1: Regulation as Strategy
outline.summary: Opening title slide for Week 1. Theme: your nervous system is not a problem to fix, it is a strategy to master.

outline.title: The Truth Nobody Told You
outline.summary: You were taught that success comes from pushing harder. Nobody told you that the nervous system running on threat cannot access creativity, pricing power, or expansion.

outline.title: The Three Files Running Your Life
outline.summary: Three internal files: The Worth File, The Safety File, The Enough File. Every decision you make runs through one of these.

outline.title: The Worth File
outline.summary: What you believe you deserve. Drives pricing, how you receive compliments, whether you negotiate, whether you ask.

outline.title: The Safety File
outline.summary: What your nervous system believes is safe to be visible, loud, controversial, wealthy, or different.

outline.title: The Enough File
outline.summary: What you believe about rest, pause, and existing without producing. The robe theory lives here.

outline.title: Regulation Is Not Calm
outline.summary: Regulation does not mean you stop feeling. It means you stop being run by what you feel. The difference between responding and reacting.

outline.title: What Soft Power Actually Is
outline.summary: Not being nice. Not being quiet. Operating from a regulated internal state so your external actions come from choice, not fear.

outline.title: This Week's Work
outline.summary: Complete the Soft Power Operating System Audit in The Room. Bring honest answers to Call 2. Not polished. Honest.

outline.title: You Are Worth Investing In
outline.summary: Closing slide. The decision you made to be here was the first act of soft power. Everything else follows from that.

outline.title: Call 2: The Internal Update
outline.summary: Opening title slide for Week 2. Theme: the story running in your head about money, worth, and what you are allowed to have is not the truth. It is a file. Files can be updated.

outline.title: You Have a File
outline.summary: Every woman in this room has a file on money. It was written before you were 10 years old. You have been running it ever since.

outline.title: What the File Says
outline.summary: Four common money files: Money is hard. Money changes people. I am not the kind of person who has money. I have to earn my place. Which one is yours?

outline.title: How the File Shows Up
outline.summary: Undercharging. Over-delivering. Apologizing for your prices. Waiting to raise rates until you feel ready. Giving discounts nobody asked for.

outline.title: You Can Update the File
outline.summary: The file is not you. It is a story. Stories can be rewritten. Not by thinking differently — by acting from a different place and letting the evidence accumulate.

outline.title: The Price Is Information
outline.summary: What you charge tells people what you believe you are worth. Not what you are worth. What you believe. Those are different things. One of them is changeable.

outline.title: The Nervous System Reset
outline.summary: Five steps. Use it before every important decision, call, or piece of content. It is in The Room. Use it this week.

outline.title: This Week's Work
outline.summary: Make one decision this week from the updated file. Not the old one. One decision. Bring it to Call 3.

outline.title: The File Is Not the Truth
outline.summary: Closing slide. You have been living inside a story someone else wrote. This week you start writing your own.

outline.title: Call 3: Visibility Without Performance
outline.summary: Opening title slide for Week 3. Theme: the content you have been avoiding is the content your people need most.

outline.title: The Performance Trap
outline.summary: You have been creating content for the version of you that is already there. Polished. Arrived. Safe. That version does not convert. The real one does.

outline.title: Your Most Controversial Opinion Is Your Most Valuable Asset
outline.summary: The thing you soften, qualify, and add disclaimers to — that is the thing that makes people stop scrolling. The robe theory. The goodbye theory. Both controversial. Both viral.

outline.title: Why You Keep Softening
outline.summary: The Safety File. Being visible feels like a threat. The nervous system does not know the difference between a predator and a comment section. Regulation is what makes visibility possible.

outline.title: The Version You Keep Just Out of Reach
outline.summary: There is a version of you that says the thing without the disclaimer. Charges the price without the apology. Posts the video without checking it 12 times. She is not a future version. She is you, regulated.

outline.title: The Soft Power Content Formula
outline.summary: Observation + Reframe + Permission. Name what people are living. Show them why it is happening. Give them permission to do it differently. Every viral piece of content follows this formula.

outline.title: This Week's Work
outline.summary: Post the piece of content you have been avoiding. Before Call 4. No disclaimers. No softening. Bring what happened to the final call.

outline.title: The Content You Avoid Is the Content That Converts
outline.summary: Closing slide. The most powerful thing you can do this week is say the true thing.

outline.title: Call 4: The Integration
outline.summary: Opening title slide for Week 4. Theme: this is not the end. This is the beginning of operating from a different place permanently.

outline.title: Look at How Far You Have Come
outline.summary: Four weeks ago you walked into this room as one version of yourself. Look at who is here now. The shift is real. The evidence is in your decisions this month.

outline.title: What Actually Changed
outline.summary: Not your strategy. Not your content plan. The internal operating system. The file. The permission you gave yourself. That is what changed. Everything else follows from that.

outline.title: How to Make It Permanent
outline.summary: The Integration Protocol. Five minutes daily. Fifteen minutes weekly. One quarterly audit. Not a practice. An operating system.

outline.title: Your Three Non-Negotiables
outline.summary: Write them now. The three things you will not go back on. The price floor. The content you will no longer soften. The room you will no longer stay in past its time.

outline.title: What Comes Next
outline.summary: The Integration Protocol is in The Room. The community stays open. The recordings are yours. And the woman who walked in four weeks ago is not the woman leaving today.

outline.title: You Already Know
outline.summary: Closing slide. You do not need permission. You never did. The robe is yours. The pause is yours. The price is yours. Go be the woman you already are.
